hero.headline:
Sell anywhere.
Rule everywhere.
hero.copy: cvhome is the operating table for merchants who outgrew one storefront. Many markets, many languages, many currencies. One command.

story.heading: Most platforms give you a store. We give you a territory.

openMarket.title: Open a market in a minute
openMarket.copy: A new store is a decision, not a project. Choose where you want to sell and it is standing before the coffee cools.

localLanguage.title: Speak the local language
localLanguage.copy: Every word your customers read, in their language and their currency, without running four teams to keep it true.

oneSeat.title: One seat, every store
oneSeat.copy: Switch markets the way you switch tabs. The numbers, the orders and the shelves all answer to the same login.

marta.quote: We ran three storefronts on three different tools before this. Consolidating them took an afternoon, and I finally see one stock number instead of three that disagree.

tobias.quote: Opening a new market used to be a project with a budget. Now it is a form. The tax and currency rules come preconfigured per region, which is the part I dreaded.

amina.quote: Arabic and English side by side in the same product form is what sold us. Translators work in the admin directly instead of passing spreadsheets back and forth.

daniel.quote: Support answered a payout question in under two hours on a Saturday. That mattered more than any feature on the pricing page.

camille.quote: The storefront builder gave us something on brand without a developer. We hired one later for the checkout, not for the basics.

priya.quote: Banners, pages and FAQ entries all publish per store per language. Our seasonal campaigns went from a two-week scramble to a Monday morning.

quote.text: “We opened Germany on a Tuesday morning and took our first order before lunch.”
quote.attribution: Head of Commerce · Acme Supply Holdings

reset.message: Choose a new password for {{name}}. They will not be told — you will need to pass it on yourself.
reset.handoverHint: Nothing on this platform sends email, so hand the password over yourself and ask them to change it.
reset.weak: Use at least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

toast.passwordReset: A new password was set for {{name}}.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitle: Everyone who has been asked to join this organization.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.message: Invite someone to give them access to this organization's stores.

invite.title: Invite someone to join
invite.message: They will join this organization with the role you choose. They need a cvhome account to accept.
invite.invalid: Enter a valid email address and choose a role.
invite.noMailHint: Nothing is emailed. You will be given a link to send them yourself.

issued.title: Send them this link
issued.message: The invitation for {{email}} is ready. Copy the link and send it to them however you normally would.
issued.warning: This is the only time this link can be shown. Close this and it cannot be recovered — you would have to resend the invitation, which creates a different link.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.message: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working. You can invite them again later.

acceptInvitation.title: Join this organization
acceptInvitation.message: You have been invited to join. Accepting adds your account to the organization and gives you access to its stores.
acceptInvitation.hint: An invitation can only be accepted once.

joined.title: You are in
joined.message: Your account has been added to the organization. You can open the console now.

refused.title: This invitation cannot be used
refused.noToken: This link is missing its invitation token, so there is nothing to accept.
refused.hint: It may have already been used, been revoked, or expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

story.heading: One console, every store
story.copy: Joining an organization gives you access to the stores its administrators have put you on.
story.point1: Your own sign-in — nothing is shared
story.point2: The stores and permissions your administrator chose
story.point3: An invitation can only be accepted once

heading.title: Your account
heading.context: How you are signed in, and how the console looks to you

account.title: Account
account.limited: The console can only see your username and your roles. Your name and email address live in the sign-in service and are not sent to it yet, so there is nothing here to edit.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: How the console looks and reads.
preferences.thisBrowserOnly: These are remembered in this browser only. There is nowhere to keep them against your account yet, so they will not follow you to another device.

heading.title: Platform overview
heading.context: Organizations and stores created across the whole platform

notice.countsOnly: These are counts, not money. Nothing on the platform aggregates revenue or subscription value yet.

empty.title: No organizations yet
empty.message: Every organization created on the platform will appear here.

create.title: New organization
create.message: Creates the organization and its first administrator together. If the address is already registered, neither is created.
create.passwordHint: 6 to 12 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
create.unnamedHint: The organization will be listed under this email address until someone gives it a name.
create.passwordWeak: The password does not meet the rule above.
create.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

noMatches.title: No organizations matched
noMatches.message: Nothing on the platform matches that name, address or status. Clear the filters to see every organization.

overview.name: Name
overview.ownerLede: The administrator this organization was created with. Setting a password here changes theirs.
overview.noOwnerReason: No owner account is recorded for this organization, so there is nobody to set a password for.

stores.title: Stores
stores.readOnly: Read-only: a store is administered by its own organization.

empty.title: No stores yet
empty.message: This organization has not created a store.

stores.billingUnknown: Billing has no subscription recorded for this store, or could not be reached. Either way it does not mean the store has lapsed.

users.title: Users
users.lede: Every account uaa holds for this organization, including administrators who belong to no store.

empty.title: No accounts
empty.message: uaa holds no account carrying this organization's identifier.

empty.title: Not available yet
empty.message: Every rename, suspension and closure is recorded, but no endpoint returns those records yet.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.message: The organization can be resumed afterwards; nothing is deleted.
suspend.consequence: Every store this organization owns stops being usable immediately, including its storefronts' console.
suspend.reasonHint: Optional. Recorded in the audit trail beside your name.

resume.title: Resume {{name}}?
resume.message: The organization and every store it owns become usable again.

close.title: Close {{name}}?
close.message: Closing is final: there is no transition out of it. Every store the organization owns stops being usable and cannot be brought back from here.
close.confirmationLabel: Type the organization's name to confirm:

ownerReset.title: Set the owner's password
ownerReset.message: Sets a new password for the account that owns {{name}}.
ownerReset.hint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
ownerReset.handoverHint: Nothing on the platform sends email, so you will need to pass this on yourself.
ownerReset.weak: The password does not meet the rule above.
ownerReset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

heading.title: Pods
heading.context: The deployments that host every store

notice.stateOnDetail: Lifecycle, health and capacity are per pod — open one to see them.

empty.title: No pods registered
empty.message: A store cannot be provisioned until at least one pod exists.

noMatches.title: No pods matched
noMatches.message: No pod has that name or endpoint. Clear the search to see the whole fleet.

heading.newContext: Adds a deployment to the registry the gateway routes from

state.title: State
state.lifecycleNote: Lifecycle decides placement only. A draining pod keeps its route and keeps serving the stores already on it.
state.capacityDisagrees: The registry counts {{registry}} here while tenancy has {{placed}}. Placement decisions use the registry's number.

form.editableFields: Only the name and the endpoint can be changed after a pod is registered. Visibility, region and capacity are set by the registry.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Letters, digits and hyphens. Unique across the platform.
form.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits and hyphens only.
form.endpointHint: The absolute URL the gateway routes this pod's traffic to.
form.endpointInvalid: Enter an absolute http or https URL.
form.ownerHint: Naming an organization makes the pod private to it. Leave it shared for a public pod.
form.ownerFixed: The owner is set when a pod is registered and cannot be changed afterwards.

drain.title: Drain {{name}}?
drain.message: No new store will be placed here. The stores already on it keep working and keep their route — this is the safe way to retire a pod.

resume.title: Resume {{name}}?
resume.message: The pod becomes a candidate for new store placements again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: Nothing checks whether stores are still on this pod, and there is no undo: every store placed here would be left pointing at a deployment the registry no longer knows. Drain is the safe operation.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type the pod's name to confirm:

toast.drained: {{name}} is draining. No new stores will be placed on it.

stores.title: Stores on this pod
stores.subtitle: From tenancy, which owns the placement. Read-only: a store is administered by its own organization.

empty.title: No stores here
empty.message: Nothing has been placed on this pod. Deleting it strands nobody.

noMatches.title: No stores matched
noMatches.message: No store on this pod has that name or id. Clear the search to see them all.

notice.noSearch: Accounts can be narrowed by organization only — uaa's admin list has no search over names, usernames or addresses.

noMatches.message: No account carries this organization's identifier. Clear the filter to see every account.

reset.handoverHint: Nothing on the platform sends email, so you will need to pass this on yourself.
reset.weak: The password does not meet the rule above.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
